name: mnml AI
original_description: mnml is the AI studio for architectural design and visualization, inside ChatGPT. Bring a sketch, a site photo or a SketchUp, Revit or Rhino view, say what it shows, and get a photoreal render back in the chat. Exteriors, interiors, landscapes, masterplans and floor plans. Mark one part of an image to change it and keep the rest. Make up to four options of a brief and compare them. Extend the frame, upscale a render, or turn a still into a short clip. Nothing runs until you confirm it, every render uses your own mnml.ai account, and each one is saved to your mnml library and projects, ready to continue in Studio.
description_scope: ChatGPT詳細画面の提供元の英語説明。
